title: The Quran: Surah 111, al-Masad (Thorns)
author: Tradução inglesa de Talal Itani (ClearQuran)
tradition: Texto sagrado do Islão, século VII
intro: Lição sobre a Surata 111. O texto inglês é a tradução de Talal Itani, reproduzida sem alterações; as notas de língua, perguntas, discussão e escrita são material pedagógico separado, baseado apenas no que o próprio texto diz.

source.title: Quran English Translation: Clear, Pure, Easy to Read Modern English
source.edition: Edition A (uses the word 'Allah' to refer to the Creator)

questions.q: According to verse 2, what did not help him?
options: His wealth and what he acquired
questions.why: O versículo 2 diz que a riqueza dele e o que ele adquiriu não lhe serviram de nada.

questions.q: 'His wealth did not avail him' means his wealth:
options: was of no use to him
questions.why: 'Avail' aqui é ser útil; 'did not avail him' é não lhe serviu de nada.

questions.q: What can we infer from verses 1 and 2 together?
options: Wealth did not protect him from being condemned
questions.why: O versículo 1 diz que ele é condenado e o versículo 2 diz que a riqueza não lhe serviu.

questions.q: How many people does the passage speak about?
options: Two: a man and his wife
questions.why: Os versículos 1 a 3 falam dele e os versículos 4 e 5 falam da mulher.

questions.q: Which contrast does the passage draw?
options: Between his wealth and what he will face
Between a city and a desert
questions.why: O versículo 2 fala do que ele tinha e o versículo 3 diz que vai arder num Fogo Flamejante.

B2.discussion: The passage says that wealth and possessions did not help. What does this suggest about the value of possessions? Give your opinion with reasons.
B2.writing: Write 80 to 100 words: Say what the verses tell us about the man and about his wife.

questions.q: What does verse 3 say will happen to him?
options: He will burn in a Flaming Fire
questions.why: O versículo 3 diz: 'He will burn in a Flaming Fire.'

questions.q: Which is closest in meaning to 'avail' in 'did not avail him'?
questions.why: 'Did not avail him' quer dizer que não lhe foi útil.

questions.q: Why might verse 2 mention both 'wealth' and 'what he acquired'?
options: To stress that nothing he owned or gained helped him
To say his wealth and his gains were different sizes
To ask a question about money
questions.why: Ao juntar a riqueza e o que ele adquiriu, o texto cobre tudo o que ele possuía ou ganhou.

questions.q: Verse 1 repeats 'condemned'. What does the repetition do?
options: It emphasises the judgement, first on his hands and then on him
questions.why: 'Condemned are the hands... and he is condemned' repete o julgamento, primeiro nas mãos e depois na pessoa.

questions.q: Which statement is best supported by the passage?
options: His possessions changed what is described in verse 3
His possessions did not change what is described in verse 3
His wife owned more than he did
The passage says nothing about possessions
questions.why: O versículo 2 diz que a riqueza e o que adquiriu não lhe serviram de nada, e o versículo 3 descreve o que o espera.

C1.discussion: The text names a specific man and his wife. How does naming individuals change the way a reader receives a warning, compared with a general statement?
C1.writing: Write 120 to 150 words: Explain how verses 2 and 3 are linked in meaning.

questions.q: What is around her neck, according to verse 5?
questions.why: O versículo 5 diz: 'Around her neck is a rope of thorns.'

questions.q: 'The hands of' in verse 1 is an example of:
options: a part standing for the whole person
questions.why: As mãos representam a pessoa inteira; é uma figura em que a parte substitui o todo.

questions.q: What do 'Flaming Fire', 'firewood' and 'thorns' have in common as images?
options: They form a related set of images around burning and harshness
questions.why: O fogo (versículo 3), a lenha (versículo 4) e os espinhos (versículo 5) criam um conjunto de imagens ligadas a arder e a algo áspero.

questions.q: Verse 3 says 'burn in a Flaming Fire' and verse 4 says 'the firewood carrier'. What link do the words create?
options: A link between fire and firewood
A link between wealth and thorns
A link between hands and neck
questions.why: 'Fire' no versículo 3 e 'firewood' no versículo 4 ligam os dois versículos pelo campo do fogo.

questions.q: Which reading of the structure is best supported?
options: Verses 1 and 2 give the judgement and the failure of possessions; verse 3 gives the outcome; verses 4 and 5 extend the picture to his wife with concrete images
The passage is a list of ten separate facts
The passage moves from the future to the past
questions.why: Cada grupo de versículos tem uma função clara: julgamento e riqueza (1 e 2), consequência (3) e descrição da mulher (4 e 5).

C2.discussion: The passage uses concrete, physical images (hands, fire, firewood, rope, thorns) rather than abstract terms. How does this shape its impact on the reader?
C2.writing: Write 150 to 200 words: Analyse how imagery and structure work together in the five verses, referring to specific words.
